name: bank.doc-relevance

modules.name: doc-relevance
modules.purpose: Retrieved-documentation relevance — a pre-filter in front of doc chunks from context7, a search, or a crawl, before they enter a prompt. Original recombine rule (prose, not yet a decision rule): Admit on answersTheQuestion, or on (isApiSurface OR isRunnableExample) with specificity >= 2. Route versionRisk chunks to a version check rather than discarding them. Rank admitted chunks by specificity in code.

answersTheQuestion.instructions: Does this chunk contain the specific information the stated question asks for, rather than merely being about the same topic?

criteria.true: The answer is present in this text.
criteria.false: Same subject area, but the specific answer is not here.

answersTheQuestion.note: migrated verbatim from question-bank/bank.ts; polarity not declared there, so declare it before use

isApiSurface.instructions: Does this chunk define a callable surface — a signature, parameters, types, or return shape?
isApiSurface.note: migrated verbatim from question-bank/bank.ts; polarity not declared there, so declare it before use

isRunnableExample.instructions: Does this chunk contain code that could be run or copied as-is?
isRunnableExample.note: migrated verbatim from question-bank/bank.ts; polarity not declared there, so declare it before use

versionRisk.instructions: Does this text refer to a version, deprecation, or migration, so that it might describe behaviour that has since changed?
versionRisk.note: migrated verbatim from question-bank/bank.ts; polarity not declared there, so declare it before use

specificity.instructions: How specific is this text about how to actually do the thing?
criteria: Explains the idea without the mechanics.
Gives exact names, signatures, or code.
specificity.note: migrated verbatim from question-bank/bank.ts; polarity not declared there, so declare it before use

notForJev.judgement: Is this chunk a duplicate of another chunk?
notForJev.instead: Hashing or embeddings in code — it evaluates one state at a time.

notForJev.judgement: Which of these 20 chunks is best?
notForJev.instead: Score each separately, rank in code. There is no cross-item comparison.
Compare against the installed package version in code. versionRisk only flags that a version is mentioned.
